prompt: Please generate an image: a wide banner (landscape, as wide as possible; keep all important content in the central horizontal band so it can be cropped to about 3:1) for the GitHub README of an open-source project called "meshly". meshly is a command-line tool that creates a private, encrypted, default-deny WireGuard link between two Linux servers: a VPS in the cloud and a home server behind NAT. Style: cyberpunk meets deep space. Dark background (near-black navy and deep purple) with a nebula, stars and a subtle perspective neon grid fading towards the horizon. On the left and on the right: two glowing nodes (stylized server racks or small space stations), connected by a single bright beam / tunnel of light with a faint hexagonal shield pattern around it - the only path between them. Neon cyan and magenta accents with a bit of violet, soft bloom, high contrast, clean and modern, not cluttered. In the center: the logo - a minimal geometric mark (two nodes joined by a link that subtly forms a lowercase "m" or a hexagonal mesh) followed by the wordmark "meshly" in lowercase, bold futuristic sans-serif, crisp and perfectly legible, slightly glowing. No other text, no tagline, no watermark, no extra letters. Leave some dark empty margin around the logo.
